svg.text: Sounds below the orange curve are inaudible (schematic). If quantization noise spreads over the whole MDCT window

text.font-family: DejaVu Sans, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: before the onset and the window is longer than pre-masking, the noise is heard as “pre-echo”; so codecs use short windows at transients.
